meta.notes: The trim pattern. asset_id names its two layers in this namespace: textures/trims/entity/humanoid/frost_studs.png for the helmet, chestplate and boots and textures/trims/entity/humanoid_leggings/frost_studs.png for the leggings, studs drawn by MSM in eight greys. The .png.mcmeta beside each names its palette key, textures/palettes/frost_studs_trim_key.png (the same eight greys, lightest first), so the game swaps each grey for the trim material's colour at the same place. description is the tooltip line; decal false draws the trim over the armour's own colours.
